intuition: A square ending at a cell can extend only as far as its top, left, and top-left neighbors allow.

brute_force.approach: Try every top-left cell and expand candidate squares while checking their borders.

optimal.approach: Use a one-dimensional DP row where each one-cell stores one plus the minimum of its three neighboring square sizes.

edge_cases: An empty matrix or one with no ones has area zero.
A one-cell matrix containing one has area one.
Track the side length and return its square.
